children: China's crude oil imports in August were down 23.4% from a year earlier, according to customs data released on Tuesday.
Oil imports in August stood at 37.93 million metric tons, or 8.93 million barrels per day, data showed.
China's January-to-August crude oil imports fell 14.6% to 320.9 million metric tons.
China's August natural gas imports, including LNG and pipeline gas, stood at 10.33 million tons, down 12.9% from a year earlier.
In the first eight months, natural gas imports stood at 78.23 million tons, down 4.4% year on year.
China's refined oil product exports, including gasoline, diesel, kerosene and fuel oil, totalled 6.01 million tons in August, up 12.7% year on year and 29% month on month.
In the first eight months, China's refined oil product exports totalled 34.24 million tons, down 9.6% from the same period last year.
